_README: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH. Never quote a price from memory or from chat — read it from here. Every field carries a `_source` or is marked UNCONFIRMED. Do not delete an UNCONFIRMED marker without a real answer from the operator.

business.what_they_sell: A white-label booking, payments and customer-messaging system for salons — one instance per business, on the salon's own link.
business.sold_to: Salon owners: hair, barbering, nails, lashes, beauty clinics.
business.website_url: UNCONFIRMED — operator left this blank in the brief. The showcase site in this repo is not yet deployed to a known URL.
business.contact_email: UNCONFIRMED — src/site.config.ts still carries the placeholder hello@kairo.app and the site README flags it as the one thing to change before launch.

audience.status: WORKING HYPOTHESIS — not confirmed by the operator
audience.hypothesis: Owner-operators of small Melbourne salons, roughly 1–10 chairs, who currently run on a paper diary plus a spreadsheet, or on a marketplace/subscription platform they resent paying. The buyer is the person who both cuts hair and does the admin at 9pm.
audience._source: Inferred from src/components/Contrast.tsx, WhyNotThem.tsx and journey.ts. Must be replaced with the operator's answer.

instagram.account_type: UNCONFIRMED — business vs creator decides which music library is licensed. Business accounts get royalty-free only; trending chart audio will mute the post.
instagram.api_access: NONE — this system has no Instagram API credentials. Every account number is therefore `unmeasured` until the operator supplies figures or access.

prices.label: Kairo setup
prices._source: src/components/PaybackCalculator.tsx const SETUP = 400; corroborated in TalkToUs.tsx, ProofWall.tsx, Comparison.tsx. Read 2026-08-25.
prices.gst_status: UNCONFIRMED — nothing in the repo says whether $400 includes GST. Ask before writing a caption that implies either.

prices.label: Ongoing fee
prices._source: src/components/TalkToUs.tsx — 'no subscription, no per-booking fee and no commission'. Read 2026-08-25.

price_rules.note: These are the ONLY money figures the business asserts anywhere — the showcase site is explicit about that. Any other dollar amount in a caption is either the reader's own number (never asserted) or an invention. The Critic fails anything else.
never_assert: any competitor's price, plan tier or commission rate
any market statistic about salons, no-shows or bookings
any engagement or view count that has not been read from a live source

principles: Speech, not copy. Contractions, first person, addressed to one reader.
Plain nouns. The site says 'the diary', 'the chair', 'the front desk' — not 'your business operations'.
Concrete over abstract. '$400 once' beats 'affordable'. 'Twelve booked, four done' beats 'full visibility'.
Understated. The product is unusual enough that hype reads as doubt.
Never talk down to a salon owner. They run a business; they are not confused by software.
voice.person: First person singular or plural for Kairo, second person for the reader. Never third-person 'salon owners should'.

contractions._why: The operator's exact verdict on week-one drafts was 'the tone felt off'. The absence of contractions was the whole of it.
contractions._exempt: 'cannot' is deliberately left off this list — the product copy uses it well ('it cannot be double-booked') and contracting it weakens the line.

voice._banned_words_note: MATCH ON WORD BOUNDARIES ONLY. Substring matching flags every caption containing 'water' because 'ate' would be on a list like this. tools/critic.mjs builds \b-anchored regexes; do not change that.

banned_punctuation._why: Nothing on the showcase site uses one. An exclamation mark in a caption is the loudest tell that it was not written by the person who owns the business.

hashtags._why_band: Not a growth theory — a consistency rule so the format stays comparable week to week while the account has no measured baseline to optimise against. Revisit once content/memory/ has three weeks of real numbers.
hashtags._core_note: UNVERIFIED as performing tags. They are plausible and on-topic, not researched. /start step 5 must check real reach before these are treated as a considered choice.

offers._why: Invariant 6. A feed that reads as an ad channel gets muted, and a discount teaches the audience to wait for the next one.
offers._active_promotions_schema: Only the operator can add one. Each entry: {"what": "", "requested_by": "", "requested_on": "YYYY-MM-DD", "runs_until": "YYYY-MM-DD"}. Gloss never adds, extends or repeats an entry on its own.

asset_provenance._why: Invariant 2. AI photographs of the product misrepresent work the business did not do, and Meta auto-labels detected AI imagery. Note this bans AI photographs, not photographs.
asset_provenance._available_now: 25 genuine product screenshots in public/screenshots/ — real UI of the real system, showing a demo salon ('Luxe Hair Studio') with invented clients. These are the strongest owned visual asset and are not AI imagery.

palette._source: README.md 'The design language' + tailwind.config.js. Sampled from the product screenshots so site and software match.

caption_limits._why_first_line: Instagram truncates the caption in-feed. Anything past the fold is read only by people already convinced.
